column1: # filecat-globs.tsv - local "well-known extensions" table layered on the
# Columns (TAB separated, UTF-8; blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored):
#   pattern      glob such as *.mpq (case-insensitive; same matching rules as freedesktop globs)
#   mime         MIME type. A real registered type when one exists, otherwise
#                A type already in the freedesktop DB is reused as-is (its description wins).
#   description  short, factual. When an extension is used by several unrelated formats the
#                description says so and lists them; the byte probe decides, not this table.
#   weight       0-100. Freedesktop's default is 50. A local weight HIGHER than the freedesktop
#                match overrides it (the freedesktop type stays listed in
#                probe.mime_glob_alternatives); EQUAL weight makes both candidates and magic or
#                size settles it; LOWER is ignored for that name.
#   note         free text for maintainers (not stored in the catalog)
#   sub-class-of optional 6th column: comma separated parent MIME types. Default parent is
# Malformed lines are skipped and reported once per scan as a scan error (stage mime_local).
# Weights used here: 50 = fills a gap or ties with freedesktop, 60 = deliberately overrides it.
